articles.title: GitHub Releases · Crush: v0.33.2
articles.summary: # Pasting images from the ol’ clipboard :framed_picture: Thanks to contributor @kslamph you can now paste images from clipboard directly into Crush. Many other fixes are included to make Crush more stable and reliable as well. Enjoy! :sparkles: ## Changelog ### New! * feat: add clipboard image paste functionality to chat editor by @kslamph in https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/pull/1151 ### Fixed * fix: race in agent.go by @caarlos0 in https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/pull/1853 * fix: resolve extra headers for providers by @kujtimiihoxha in https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/pull/1764 * fix: make hyper and copilot link styled on ui by @andreynering in https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/pull/1872 * fix: try to make the search tool more reliable by @kujtimiihoxha in https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/pull/1779 * fix: mcps loading in non interactive mode by @kujtimiihoxha in https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/pull/1894 ### Other stuff * chore(README): update crus

articles.title: GitHub Releases · Remotion: v4.0.407
articles.summary: ## What's Changed * `@remotion/web-renderer`: New text renderer by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/6300 * `@remotion/media`: Remove readahead threshold by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/6295 * `@remotion/media`: Smoother playback, better handle videos with variable FPS and offset start timestamps by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/6305 * `@remotion/renderer`: Abort downloads when render fails (fix) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/6307 ## Templates * Prompt to motion graphics: Add Skills setup for Code Generation by @ASchwad in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/6298 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/compare/v4.0.406...v4.0.407
